title: Scroll Game
tagline: A game inside a smart-contract deployed on Scroll and use zero-knowledge proofs
description: A simple and well-known tic-tac-toe game for geeks. This idea was born out of a desire to create a completely decentralized game. It is a prototype, but placed in a smart contract and independent of its creator. Players interact with the contract one at a time. Each player makes a deposit of 0.01 ether. The winner takes the entire deposit. Players receive feedback on errors in the smart contract.
how_its_made: The project is fully built on Solidity 0.8.21 and tested on Foundry. The Scroll blockchain was chosen to maintain zero-knowledge proofs. The smart contract is completely independent of the creator, the creator of the contract does not take any commission. Only two users can play at the same time.
